Category: Nonprofit Charitable Organizations

Location:


Lucas James Talent Partners is recruiting on behalf of UL Research Institutes. We have an exciting opportunity for aResearch CoordinatoratUL Research Institutes. This is a remote Opportunity.

The Research Coordinator at the Institute for Research Experiences & Education (IREE) works closely with IREE’s interdisciplinary research team on the workflows, logistics, and administrative components that are critical to social science and education research. This individual is the cohesive glue across education research projects, ensuring studies are completed as planned and communication is seamless across the team. With expertise in project management and experience in social science research, the Research Coordinator plays a key support role that is integral to the execution of research projects. As a core member of the team, this individual brings a spirit of curiosity and pragmatism to each project.

UL Research Institutes:

AtUL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Research Experiences & Education teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

IREE:

The Institute for Research Experiences and Education (IREE) cultivates the next generation of safety scientists through a mix of unique educational programs, academic partnerships, and research and standards development experiences.

We translate the findings of our research institutes into compelling educational materials, bringing to life scientific concepts using contemporary best education practices to create learning opportunities for a wide variety of secondary through postgraduate students. Our academic collaborations and support for the next generation of safety scientists likewise reach across the educational spectrum, including partnerships that reach out to students who are underrepresented in STEM fields.

Through all of our programs, we aim to unlock the diverse perspectives that are essential for solving the world’s most pressing safety and sustainability issues.

What you’ll learn and achieve:

As theResearch Coordinator,you will play a key role in the rapid growth ofULas you:

Develop and maintain systems to track and administer social science research, in the following key areas.

·Team communication

oCollaborate with team leadership to ensure everyone understands their roles and responsibilities by facilitating regular team and project meetings, providing updates on progress, identifying potential roadblocks, and soliciting input from team members.
oFoster positive relationships with colleagues, internal and external collaborators, and project participants, keeping them informed about project progress, changes, and potential impacts, addressing stakeholder concerns and requests promptly and professionally.

·Research compliance and ethics

oTrack trainings and certifications, including renewals
oTrack IRB applications, including renewals

·Project workflow and documentation

oAssist in creating and maintaining project charters, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

oMaintain project documentation, including status reports and meeting summaries, and generate periodic project reports for team leadership, highlighting progress, issues, and recommendations.
oSupport data management processes and systems.

·Financial administration

oAssist in budget planning and tracking, ensuring projects are executed within the allocated budget and monitor project expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality.
oArrange for compensation for research participants

oAssist with processing vendor invoices

·Logistics for research convenings, conferences, and publications

oContribute to planning for research convenings hosted by IREE
oOrganize vendors, rentals, and meals for participants and partners
oTrack conference and publication deadlines and submissions

·Coordination for grants

oSupport grant writing in collaboration with other teams and administrators
oSupport grant administration with other organizational administrators
Perform other duties as assigned.

  • People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
  • Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
  • Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
  • Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
  • Total Rewards: All employees atUL Research Institutesare eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What makes you a great fit:

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

  • Understanding of the ethical and pragmatic requirements for applied social science research, particularly humansubjectsdata.
  • A penchant for organization balanced with an appreciation for the human needs of colleagues and collaborators.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently identify needs for projects, formulate objectives, plan and execute tasks.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills that embody collegial and professional communication with all colleagues, collaborators, and research participants.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and the capacity to adapt to changing project requirements.
  • Ability to work steadily on multiple projects and maintain an eye on the big-picture goal of each project and the mission of the organization.

Professional education and experience requirements for the role include

  • Bachelor's degree and / or demonstrated interest in social science (including but not limited to education research and learning sciences), and the processes involved in conducting and administering social science research.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or research.
  • Experience or demonstrated interest in project management.
  • Travel to conferences, team meetings, and research convenings as needed.

About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagementare nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

To learn more, visit our websitesandULSE.org.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred
  • Experience working directly with Asian or European manufacturing hubs.

We’re a global, fast-moving agency that’s obsessed with pushing creative and digital boundaries. You’ll work alongside a diverse and collaborative team, and the support to help you grow.

We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. the tests to be conducted and guides patients in the requirements of the trial.

• May perform Phlebotomy tests.

    • Good medical terminology and ability to perform conducting of vital signs
    • Strong understanding of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), with ability to learn and maintain a good working knowledge of FDA regulations and company/client SOPs and WPDs
    • Strong organizational skills and flexibility to manage workload and meet changing timelines, handling multiple tasks efficiently and effectively
    • Thorough attention to detail to ensure accuracy and efficiency in data entry
    • Strong interpersonal/customer service skills, positive attitude and good oral and written communication
    • Capable of working independently and with new site staff

    • Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.

  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s the job about?

As a Staff Software Developer at Auvik, you’ll lead through technical excellence. You’ll dive deep into our systems, tackle the hardest technical problems, and deliver production-quality solutions that improve our products and platform at scale. While your influence may extend across teams through shared tooling, mentorship, or technical guidance, your day-to-day focus will be deeply embedded in a development team — designing, coding, debugging, and shipping high-quality software alongside your teammates.

This role is ideal for a developer who wants to stay close to the codebase while still having wide-reaching technical influence and driving high-impact outcomes.

What will I be doing?

You’ll focus on:

  • Own complex technical challenges and architect scalable, performant solutions.
  • Writing clean, maintainable code — and lots of it — in languages like Go, Scala, or TypeScript (React/GraphQL).
  • Diagnosing and resolving complex production - digging across systems to find root causes and deliver lasting fixes that restore customer trust.
  • Working closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to build features that provide real value to our customers.
  • Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.
  • Leading by example in code reviews, mentoring other developers, and championing best practices in development and testing.
  • Proactively identifying and implementing technical improvements across our codebase, systems, and developer workflows.
  • Collaborating across teams to ensure consistency in implementation, performance, and user experience.
  • Helping unblock others by sharing context, reviewing designs, and contributing reusable tools, libraries, or frameworks.

What are we looking for?

  • A hands-on engineer who loves solving tough problems through code and building systems that scale.
  • A deep technical contributor with a strong grasp of system design, clean coding practices, and debugging complex issues.
  • A team player who thrives in collaborative environments and can communicate ideas effectively across functions.
  • A mentor who lifts others by pairing, sharing insights, and providing thoughtful feedback in reviews.
  • A proactive self-starter who can independently lead projects from start to finish, always looking for ways to improve.
  • Familiarity with tools and practices for logging, tracing, metrics collection, and alerting (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog, etc.).
  • You’ve tackled performance bottlenecks or scalability challenges in high-traffic systems.
  • You’ve built tooling or frameworks that boosted developer velocity.
  • You’ve contributed to open-source projects or enjoy staying sharp with side projects.
  • A deeply technical, hands-on engineer who uses AI pragmatically to solve hard problems, writes high-quality production code, debugs across distributed systems, and elevates team output through strong system design and engineering rigor.

Our Stack

  • Frontend: React (TypeScript), GraphQL
  • Backend: Go, Scala
  • Infrastructure & Data: Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS
    (… and more, depending on your area of focus)

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.



About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

Given the seasonal or project-specific nature of our environmental compliance work, ICF often hires environmental professionals as "On-Call" employees. On-Call employees are scheduled for work hours as they become available (we usually schedule work hours a few weeks ahead of time, depending on client notifications), and each on-call employee is free to accept or refuse the hours assigned to them in a given week. Job Description

Wheelhouse is a revenue management platform for the $500B+ flex rental space. Our technology empowers short & mid-length stay operators, who manage single-family homes, apartment buildings, and(in some cases) hotels - a broad & massive addressable market. Wheelhouse believes a more flexible & connected world is both inevitable & important, and we build technology to make sure the businesses that enable this lifestyle & society can thrive.
As a team, we enjoy shipping products our customers love, on time or ahead of schedule, while balancing work/life & having fun together. We’re best described as transparent & collaborative, and we strive to set our teammates up for success - both professionally & personally. We’re a remote-first, work-anywhere, and“yes - you should make time for that adventure/vacation” company, who believes that“healthy hustle” is the key to good growth.
At our core, we process massive amounts of data to give our clients a competitive edge. We track calendar data for over 14 million listings worldwide, ingesting the future calendar of availability and pricing for every single listing, every single day. This translates to a multi-terabyte, highly dynamic dataset.
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to take ownership of this massive daily ingestion engine. Working within a Ruby on Rails and Resque environment, backed by AWS RDS Postgres and Aurora as well as Athena, you will ensure our data pipelines are robust, scalable, and highly optimized. You will not only supervise and improve our existing daily ingestion but also design systems to integrate new data sources and seamlessly deliver this data to our core application.
Your mission is to guarantee the reliability, speed, and scale of our data infrastructure. You will be the technical guardian of our multi-terabyte dataset, ensuring that as we grow to track even more listings and add new data sources, our ingestion engine scales gracefully and cost-effectively without missing a beat. Our revenue management algorithms rely entirely on the daily calendar sync of these 14 million listings to price our clients' properties accurately. If our data pipelines slow down or fail, our core product cannot function.

We’re looking for someone who:

Works independently and takes ownership: You don't wait to be told what to optimize. You treat the data infrastructure as your own product, proactively identifying areas for improvement and driving them to completion.
Thinks in systems: You understand that scaling isn't just about writing faster code; it's about how Resque, PostgreSQL, and our AWS infrastructure interact. You see the big picture and understand the cascading effects of your changes.
Stays calm under pressure: Because this daily data sync is our lifeblood, pipeline hiccups are critical. You can troubleshoot complex, multi-terabyte issues methodically and keep a cool head when the pressure is on.
Communicates technical concepts clearly: You can easily translate complex data engineering constraints and architecture decisions into plain language for the wider engineering and product teams.
Values pragmatism over perfection: You know when to invest in an elegant, long-term architectural solution, and when the business just needs a robust, practical fix to keep the daily sync running smoothly.
Is obsessed with observability: You believe a system isn't finished until it's properly monitored. You build alerts and dashboards to catch anomalies and bottlenecks before they ever impact our clients.
Is super detail oriented: You intrinsically see that certain data problems can be needles in haystacks and you are process driven to build safeguards to flag the vast majority of issues before our customers notice the same.

What you'll be doing

  • Architect, optimize, and supervise the daily ingestion pipelines that process calendar data for 14+ million listings.
  • Tune and scale our AWS RDS PostgreSQL and Aurora databases to handle extreme high-throughput read/write operations and multi-TB storage.
  • Optimize background job orchestration to ensure timely and efficient data processing.
  • Design and build robust ETL processes to integrate new, complex data sources into our ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with application engineers to make diverse versions and aggregations of our data easily accessible to the core application.
  • Apply DevOps best practices to maintain and improve our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Build comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling to catch data bottlenecks before they impact the business.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Data Engineering or Backend Engineering experience, specifically dealing with massive, high-velocity datasets(multi-TB scale) and 10+ years overall engineering experience at technology companies.
  • Deep database expertise: Advanced knowledge of relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL and AWS Aurora. You must know how to tune databases, optimize complex queries, and manage large-scale indexing.
  • Strong programming skills: Proficiency in Ruby and Ruby on Rails(or a strong willingness to learn, backed by expert-level experience in a similar language like Python) to navigate our core stack.
  • Job Orchestration: Experience with background processing frameworks at scale(Resque, Sidekiq, Celery, or similar).
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, infrastructure provisioning(Terraform/CloudFormation), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Data Modeling: Strong ability to design data models that balance fast ingestion with efficient application querying.
  • Problem Solver: A track record of identifying performance bottlenecks in complex distributed systems and implementing elegant solutions.
  • Remote DNA: Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, communicate asynchronously, and manage your own"healthy hustle."

Why Join Us

  • Own the big data pipelines in a fast-growing SaaS company.
  • Directly improve the reliability and usability of our product.
  • Enjoy the power to shape your own projects and help set the direction for new development.
  • Collaborative, small-team environment where your impact is highly visible

Perks and Benefits

  • The expected base salary range for this position is between $156,000 and $180,000 depending on experience.
  • Competitive salary, cash bonus potential and equity
  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits for each US employee
  • Fidelity 401k available for each US employee
  • Unlimited PTO
  • And…more!

About Us:

Wheelhouse is a fintech platform for the $500B+ flex rental space. Most specifically, we enable short & mid-length stay providers with 1 to 100,000+ listings to earn 20%+ more from their rental properties.
In 2021, our target customer segment voted our platform“Innovation of the Year” at the Data & Revenue Management conference. This sentiment is shared by our customers, as evidenced by our platforms low churn and rapidly growing ARPU. In 2022, we closed a significant funding round, with participation from many of the best tech, travel & real estate investors. We’re lucky to have a long runway, low burn, and rapidly growing revenue.
As a team, we enjoy shipping products our customers love, on time or ahead of schedule, while balancing work/life & having fun together. We’re best described as transparent & collaborative, and we strive to set our teammates up for success - both professionally & personally. We’re a remote-first, work-anywhere, and“yes - you should make time for that adventure/vacation” company, who believes that“healthy hustle” is the key to good growth.
We’re experienced business & product builders who have founded multiple companies together, know our category extremely well, and recognize how rare/special it is to be perfectly positioned around a big opportunity with a very strong cross-functional team.
We’d be eager to say hello and learn more about you!

jobs.description:
About Avalyn:

Avalyn aims to transform the treatment paradigm for pulmonary fibrosis and other serious, rare respiratory diseases. The company is advancing optimized inhaled formulations of established antifibrotic medicines designed to deliver drug directly to the lungs, enhance local efficacy, and reduce systemic side effects. Avalyn’s AP01 program is an optimized inhaled formulation of pirfenidone currently being evaluated in MIST, a global Phase 2b clinical trial in patients with progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF). AP01 has demonstrated encouraging safety and clinical activity across Phase 1b and an ongoing, multi-year open-label extension trial, with long-term data supporting the potential to preserve lung function while improving tolerability relative to historical oral pirfenidone. Avalyn’s AP02 program is an optimized inhaled formulation of nintedanib currently being evaluated in AURA, a global Phase 2 clinical trial in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). Avalyn is also advancing AP03, an inhaled fixed-dose combination of pirfenidone and nintedanib, designed to deliver multiple antifibrotic mechanisms through a single lung-targeted platform. By leveraging its proprietary drug-device approach and deep expertise in rare respiratory disease development, Avalyn aims to establish a new standard of care in pulmonary fibrosis through inhaled, lung-targeted therapies. For more information, please visit avalynpharma.com and follow the company on LinkedIn.

Position Summary:

The Director, Clinical Development will report to the Senior Vice President, Clinical Development, providing IPF/ILD medical oversight, scientific leadership, and clinical expertise throughout the lifecycle of clinical trials, from protocol strategy and design through execution, data interpretation, clinical study reporting, and regulatory interactions. The Director, Clinical Development serves as the primary medical leader for assigned trials, with a strong focus on patient safety, scientific integrity, and clinical relevance.

The Director, Clinical Development works cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Translational Science, Data Management, and external CROs to support effective trial execution and alignment with overall program strategy. This individual provides medical direction on protocol design, safety monitoring, risk mitigation, data review, and clinical trial amendments, while serving as a key medical resource for investigators and study teams.

The role also leads medical review and interpretation of emerging safety and efficacy data, contributes to Clinical Study Reports and regulatory submissions, and supports health authority interactions, advisory boards, investigator meetings, publications, and scientific presentations.

Responsibilities:

Study Design & Strategy

  • Lead clinical trial strategy and protocol development, including endpoints, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and clinical trial design.
  • Define medical monitoring, safety, and risk mitigation strategies in partnership with the Medical Monitor.
  • Contribute to statistical analysis plan assumptions and the clinical relevance of the statistical design.
  • Support site identification and selection based on disease-area expertise.
  • Provide medical input for clinical trial amendments and study-specific regulatory interactions.

Medical Monitoring & Safety

  • Serve as the disease-state expert and provide medical guidance to the Medical Monitor and clinical trial team.
  • Review SAEs, SUSARs, safety signals, eligibility deviations, protocol exceptions, and violations with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Support development of DSMB and Safety Review Committee materials.
  • Ensure clinical trial conduct meets GCP and patient safety standards.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the medical leader for the clinical trial team, partnering closely with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Translational Science, and external CROs.
  • Provide medical guidance to site investigators and resolve clinical or disease-related questions.
  • Ensure study conduct remains aligned with overall program strategy.
  • Conduct site visits as appropriate to maintain engagement with investigators and study teams.

Data Review & Interpretation

  • Co-lead blinded data review meetings and interpret emerging safety and efficacy data.
  • Lead medical interpretation of safety and efficacy outcomes for Clinical Trial Reports (CTRs) and support interim analyses and futility assessments.

Clinical Study Report

  • Lead the development and authoring of the Clinical Study Report (CSR), including identifying the medical writer and assigning section responsibilities.

Regulatory & External Activities

  • Participate in study-specific regulatory agency interactions and co-lead development of EOP2 materials with Regulatory Affairs.
  • Respond to health authority questions related to the study.
  • Present clinical data at advisory boards and investigator meetings and support publications and congress presentations.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced clinical or scientific degree (e.g., APRN, RRT, PhD, PharmD) with 5–7+ years of experience in IPF/ILD clinical care, research, or drug development.
  • A minimum of 3–5+ years of clinical development experience, with demonstrated involvement in the design and execution of Phase 2–3 clinical trials, preferably global studies.
  • Therapeutic expertise in IPF, ILD, or a closely related respiratory disease area is required
  • Demonstrated expertise in clinical trial protocol development, including endpoints, eligibility criteria, safety monitoring, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Strong clinical judgment and commitment to patient safety, with experience evaluating safety signals, protocol deviations, and benefit-risk considerations.
  • Experience reviewing and interpreting clinical safety and efficacy data and translating findings into meaningful clinical and development decisions.
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research standards, and global regulatory requirements, with experience supporting health authority interactions.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Translational Science, and external partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage investigators, clinical sites, CROs, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic thinking and business judgment, with the ability to connect trial-level decisions to broader clinical development and program objectives.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and balance strategic responsibilities with hands-on involvement in clinical trial execution.

Our respected, growing organization has an exceptional strategy for the near term and beyond. Take your place on our strong team and help us make significant contributions to the world.

Responsibilities

  • Support investigator site identification, recruitment, onboarding, and activation activities across multiple clinical registries to achieve study timelines and business objectives.
  • Execute strategic site recruitment plans utilizing internal and external data sources to identify and prioritize qualified investigator sites.
  • Conduct site identification using resources including ClinicalTrials.gov, investigator databases, literature and publication reviews, claims data, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) referrals, clinical trial networks, and other relevant intelligence sources.

  • Coordinate team review and approval activities throughout the site selection and activation process.
  • Manage investigator onboarding activities, ensuring completion of required documentation and site activation milestones to support enrollment readiness.
  • Support or coordinate Site Qualification Visits (SQV/PSV), Site Initiation Visits (SIV), and other study start-up activities as required.
  • Utilize Salesforce, recruitment dashboards, claims data, and other business intelligence tools to monitor recruitment progress, prioritize activities, and support data-driven decision making.

  • Monitor recruitment and activation KPIs, identify risks or delays, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to maintain project timelines.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Registry Operations, Registry Leadership, legal, and other internal teams to ensure seamless site activation and operational excellence.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements, workflow enhancements, and best practices to improve recruitment efficiency, accelerate site activation, and optimize operational performance.
  • Contribute to feasibility process improvements, knowledge sharing, and training initiatives for junior team members when applicable.
  • Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, applicable regulations, and data privacy requirements.

  • Experience identifying and sourcing investigator sites using multiple internal and external data sources, including ClinicalTrials.gov, investigator databases, publication searches, claims data, KOL referrals, and clinical trial networks.
  • Strong understanding of investigator site identification, feasibility assessments, site qualification and selection, study start-up, and site activation processes.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating Site Qualification Visits (SQV/PSV), Site Initiation Visits (SIV), investigator onboarding, or related study start-up activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting aggressive recruitment and activation timelines.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting recruitment metrics, tracking KPIs, identifying trends, and driving continuous process improvement.
  • Experience using Salesforce, CTMS, or other clinical operations and customer relationship management systems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build collaborative relationships across investigators, sponsors, and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, decision-making, and project management skills.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate documentation and reporting.
  • Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Clinical Trial Associate (CTA), Study Start-Up, Site Activation, or Site Management experience is highly preferred.
  • Knowledge of GCP, clinical research regulations, confidentiality requirements, and data privacy principles is preferred.

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.

You will be responsible for onboarding and ramp programs, ongoing skill development, GTM readiness for product launches, playbook development, and building the systems and processes that help our revenue teams perform consistently and confidently.

You will act as the connective tissue between the field and the business — surfacing insights from frontline teams, identifying gaps in messaging, skills, or process, and translating them into scalable programs that drive measurable improvement. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. Your work will directly shape how effectively DoorDash's go-to-market teams engage customers, win deals, and grow long-term relationships with hospitality operators.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and evolution of the organization's enterprise data architecture. This role is responsible for defining data strategies, establishing architecture standards, and designing scalable data solutions that enable business intelligence, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to ensure data is accessible, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Define and maintain the organization's enterprise data architecture, ensuring alignment with business strategy and technology roadmaps.
  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models that support enterprise-wide data initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise data architecture principles, standards, and best practices to promote consistency and scalability.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, data inventories, and data flow diagrams.

Data Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement enterprise data strategies aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish and promote data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and data management best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop data roadmaps and support the successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
  • Participate in project governance activities to ensure compliance with enterprise data architecture standards.

Data Integration & Platform Design

  • Design scalable data integration solutions that enable efficient data movement across enterprise platforms.
  • Architect modern data ecosystems, including cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse environments.
  • Oversee data migration initiatives, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data integration strategies.
  • Recommend improvements to data transformation, loading methodologies, and overall data architecture using modern technologies and industry best practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable architectural solutions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, application development, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver enterprise data capabilities.
  • Communicate architectural concepts and solution designs effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to data engineering, business intelligence, and analytics teams.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for enterprise data management, integration, and architecture practices.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to improve enterprise data capabilities.
  • Promote adoption of modern cloud-native data platforms, big data technologies, streaming architectures, and advanced data engineering practices.

Data Security & Compliance

  • Ensure enterprise data solutions comply with data privacy regulations, security standards, and organizational governance requirements.
  • Collaborate with security teams to implement appropriate controls for data protection, access management, and regulatory compliance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, enterprise data management, or related roles.
  • Extensive experience designing enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and modern cloud-based data architectures.
  • Strong background in enterprise data governance, metadata management, master data management, and data quality initiatives.
  • Experience designing and implementing cloud-based data solutions using platforms such as AWS or equivalent cloud providers.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and providing architectural guidance across enterprise data initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance best practices.
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS) are an advantage.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Enterprise Data Architecture & Data Modeling
  • Data Governance & Data Management Frameworks
  • SQL, NoSQL, Cloud Databases
  • Data Warehousing & Data Lakehouse Architecture
  • Apache Iceberg & Medallion Architecture
  • ETL/ELT Design & Data Integration
  • AWS Cloud Services
  • AWS Glue, Amazon DMS, Informatica Cloud Data Integration
  • AWS Glue Data Catalog
  • Informatica Cloud Data Quality
  • Informatica Customer 360 (MDM)
  • Big Data & Data Engineering
  • Cloud Data Warehouses
  • Data Streaming Technologies
  • API-based Data Delivery
  • Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
  • Data Security & Regulatory Compliance

Preferred Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences, including executive leadership.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement and adoption of emerging data technologies.

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Digital Success Strategy Manager owns Jamf’s digital customer success strategy: the one-to-many, technology-led engagement model that drives adoption, retention, and value at scale. Building on deep digital-success expertise, the role designs a modernized, AI-powered evolution of that motion and defines what it should do and why. It partners with a Digital Success Engineer who builds the supporting automation and tooling, and it owns the adoption and retention outcomes the strategy delivers.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Owns the digital customer success strategy: the segmentation, lifecycle, and one-to-many engagement model that delivers adoption, retention, and value to customers outside high-touch coverage.
  • Designs and leads a modernized, AI-powered evolution of the digital motion, identifying where AI, automation, and agents can scale proactive, personalized engagement and setting the roadmap to get there.
  • Defines the strategy, requirements, and priorities that shape the digital motion’s tooling and automation, including the capabilities the Digital Success Engineer role must build. Partners closely with that role so the tooling serves the engagement model.
  • Owns the adoption, retention, and coverage outcomes of the digital motion, defining the metrics and targets and iterating the strategy based on results.
  • Designs digital engagement programs end to end, including customer journeys, campaigns, in-app guidance, and lifecycle touchpoints, in partnership with the Customer Success Management organization, Marketing, and Product.
  • Partners with the Customer Success Analytics Engineer and data teams to ground the motion in customer health, adoption, and usage signals, so engagement is targeted by data rather than guesswork.
  • Establishes governance and guardrails for automated customer communication, ensuring outreach is accurate, on-brand, appropriately reviewed, and safe to run at scale.
  • Aligns cross-functional stakeholders (CSM, Marketing, Product, and Operations) around the digital success strategy and roadmap, building buy-in and driving adoption without direct authority.
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert and internal advocate for digital and scaled customer success, bringing external best practices and a modernized vision to Customer Success leadership.
  • Works with autonomy to execute the strategy and roadmap, exercising judgment on day-to-day priorities and escalating novel or highly cross-functional decisions for guidance.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What we are looking for:

  • Deep expertise in digital customer success: segmentation, lifecycle design, tech-touch engagement, and the tooling that powers it (required)

  • Experience translating strategy into clear requirements and priorities that a technical builder can execute against (required)

  • Familiarity with customer success and engagement platforms such as Gainsight, Salesforce, and in-app or digital-engagement tooling (preferred)

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE At Rightway, we believe managing your medications should feel simple, personal, and empowering.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

At Rightway, we believe managing your medications should feel simple, personal, and empowering. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape the pharmacy experience our members use every day to take ownership of their medicine cabinet, connect with clinicians and pharmacists, and find the lowest-cost path to healthier lives.

In this role, you’ll be the owner of the digital pharmacy journey across our web and mobile apps—from a member’s first search for a medication, to choosing where to fill it, to tracking their ongoing prescriptions in a personalized digital medicine cabinet. You’ll design experiences that make pharmacy care seamless: clear benefits, easy checkout, timely reminders, and effortless access to retail, mail order, and specialty options.

Your north star: driving member delight, engagement, and outcomes. That means building tools people want to use every day, supporting smarter choices, and creating trust through every interaction.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own and evolve the vision for Rightway’s digital pharmacy experience, keeping members at the center of every product decision.
  • Build intuitive, engaging features—like drug search, cost transparency, benefits clarity, and personalized reminders—that turn complex pharmacy benefits into simple member experiences.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, and clinical experts to create elegant solutions that balance usability with operational and regulatory needs.
  • Use experimentation, analytics, and member feedback to continually improve adoption, satisfaction, and outcomes.
  • Inspire the team with insights about member behavior and trends in digital health, translating them into actionable roadmaps.
  • Lead and mentor an Associate Product Manager, fostering a culture of creativity, empathy, and data-driven decision making.
  • Stay curious—explore how AI, digital retail, and consumer health innovations can push our member experience forward.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally blending consumer product and healthcare expertise.
  • Strong track record of shipping B2C experiences that drive engagement and habit formation.
  • Comfortable with experimentation, behavioral design, and data-driven optimization.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator; able to rally engineers, designers, and clinicians around the member voice.
  • Passionate about building healthcare experiences that are as intuitive and delightful as the best consumer apps.

EXTRA CREDIT

  • Background in digital retail pharmacy or PBM member experiences.
  • Experience with regulated markets (Medicare) or pharmacy data standards.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI-powered product development or prototyping.
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field (MBA, MPH, technical discipline).

COMPENSATION: $146,000 - $200,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @ email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $200mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, firstOur humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possibleWe always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commitWe believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate gritChanging healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delightHealthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are hiring a Manager, Growth Marketing to help execute and elevate PartnerCentric's brand presence across the performance marketing industry.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Manager, Growth Marketing to help execute and elevate PartnerCentric's brand presence across the performance marketing industry. Reporting to the VP, Growth Marketing, you will lead the execution of podcast marketing, social media, content strategy, industry events and lifecycle marketing that strengthen our reputation, build relationships, and support business growth.

Working closely with the VP of Growth Marketing, CEO, Sales, Client Services, Product, and external partners, you'll ensure PartnerCentric consistently shows up in the right places with the right message — and nurtures the audiences who find us. You'll coordinate campaigns, manage external relationships, execute brand initiatives, and optimize programs that increase awareness, engagement, and market credibility.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing ideas to life, managing multiple initiatives, building relationships, and turning strategy into measurable execution.

This is a fully remote position, but candidates must reside and physically perform the work within the United States. We are only considering applicants who possess unrestricted, independent work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require employer sponsorship.

A Week in the Life

Monday Review podcast, social, event, lifecycle, and brand performance with the VP of Growth Marketing. Align on weekly priorities, upcoming campaigns, executive opportunities, and project timelines. Coordinate with internal teams and agency partners.

Tuesday Execute podcast marketing campaigns, coordinate guest outreach, prepare executive communications, and support speaking opportunities, media placements, and award submissions. Repurpose content across social and marketing channels.

Wednesday Meet with podcast guests, conference organizers, strategic partners, and vendors. Coordinate upcoming events, sponsorships, executive appearances, and relationship-building opportunities.

Thursday Partner with Marketing, Sales, Client Services, and Product teams to execute webinars, case studies, newsletters, HubSpot nurture/lifecycle campaigns, partner campaigns, customer stories, and thought leadership initiatives that support company priorities.

Friday Review campaign performance, podcast growth, social engagement, event metrics, lifecycle email performance, and project status. Share recommendations and next steps with the VP of Growth Marketing while preparing priorities for the following week.

Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Management

  • Develop and maintain a content calendar spanning podcast, social, PR, events, and lifecycle marketing to ensure consistent, on-brand messaging.
  • Repurpose long-form content (podcast episodes, webinars, case studies) into articles, social posts, newsletters, and sales enablement assets.
  • Own the end-to-end content management process: intake, drafting/editing, review and approval workflows, publishing, and archiving across the website, blog, and content library.
  • Own the case study program end-to-end: identify strong customer stories, coordinate with Client Services and Sales to secure customer participation, conduct interviews, and manage drafting, approval, and publishing.
  • Maintain a content asset inventory (blogs, one-pagers, case studies, videos, decks) and ensure assets stay current, on-brand, and easy for Sales and Client Services to find and use.
  • Manage relationships with freelance writers, editors, and designers supporting content production.
  • Ensure content is optimized for SEO, accessibility, and distribution across channels.

Social Media Management

  • Own the day-to-day management of PartnerCentric's social media channels (LinkedIn, X, etc.), including content calendar, scheduling, and publishing.
  • Grow follower base, engagement, and share of voice through consistent, high-quality organic content.
  • Support executive/founder personal brand presence on social platforms.

Podcast Strategy & Marketing

  • Manage the day-to-day execution and promotion of PartnerCentric's podcast.
  • Develop promotional campaigns that increase audience growth, engagement, and reach.
  • Source, recruit, and coordinate podcast guests aligned with company priorities.
  • Coordinate podcast appearances for company executives on external shows.
  • Repurpose podcast content into videos, articles, newsletters, social content, and other marketing assets.
  • Track podcast performance and recommend optimizations.

Events & Industry Engagement

  • Coordinate conference participation, sponsorships, networking events, executive dinners, and partner gatherings.
  • Execute event marketing plans that maximize visibility and relationship-building opportunities.
  • Manage event logistics, timelines, vendors, and promotional activities.
  • Support partner marketing initiatives tied to conferences and industry events.
  • Track event performance and provide post-event recommendations.

Lifecycle Marketing (HubSpot)

  • Build, manage, and optimize lifecycle email campaigns (newsletters, nurture sequences, event/webinar follow-ups) within HubSpot.
  • Segment and maintain contact workflows to support targeted, relevant communications across the funnel.
  • Partner with Sales and Client Services to align lifecycle messaging with the customer journey.
  • Track email performance (opens, clicks, conversions) and iterate on messaging, cadence, and segmentation.
  • Maintain HubSpot hygiene and ensure marketing/sales alignment on lead handoff and scoring, where applicable.

Marketing Operations & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with the Growth Marketing and marketing operations team on integrated campaigns supporting awareness and demand generation.
  • Manage external agencies, contractors, freelancers, and vendors.
  • Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, budgets, and communications across multiple initiatives.
  • Help improve processes for podcast promotion, social media, lifecycle marketing, and event marketing.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Track and report on KPIs across podcast growth marketing initiatives.
  • Provide regular reporting and recommendations to the VP of Growth Marketing.
  • Support continuous optimization through performance analysis and market insights.

Role Requirements

  • 5+ years of marketing experience in communications, events, social media, and content.
  • Experience managing podcasts, social media channels, executive communications, lifecycle/email marketing, content management, or growth marketing programs.
  • Experience developing customer case studies/success stories, including coordinating customer interviews and approvals.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot (or a comparable marketing automation/CRM platform) for email and lifecycle campaign management.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience managing agency, vendor, or partner relationships.
  • Comfortable collaborating across marketing, sales, client services, and executive leadership.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to execute with minimal oversight.
  • Analytical mindset with experience measuring campaign and program performance.
  • Understanding and inspired by AI tools (Claude, Lovable).
  • Interest in affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, AI visibility, and performance marketing.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Content & Social Performance Content output/cadence, social follower growth, engagement rate, and content repurposing efficiency.

Podcast Performance Audience growth, downloads, engagement, guest quality, and promotional effectiveness.

Events & Partnerships Successful execution of conferences, sponsorships, executive events, partner initiatives, lead generation and post-event outcomes.

Lifecycle Marketing Email/nurture campaign performance (open, click, conversion rates), list growth and health, and funnel progression tied to lifecycle touchpoints and generating demand.

Operational Excellence On-time project delivery, agency/vendor management, budget adherence, and cross-functional collaboration.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Remote-first work environment
  • Generous Flex Day policy and paid holidays
  • Ongoing professional development and leadership opportunities
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools and technology
  • A collaborative, people-first culture focused on innovation and continuous growth

About PartnerCentric

PartnerCentric is a leading performance marketing agency helping brands accelerate growth through Affiliate Marketing, Creator & Influencer Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, and emerging digital channels.

For more than 20 years, we've helped some of the world's most recognized brands build high-performing partner programs that deliver measurable business results. Today, we're evolving beyond traditional affiliate management to create integrated performance marketing solutions that connect affiliate, creator, content, AI, partnerships, and emerging technologies into one cohesive strategy.

We're a remote-first company built on ownership, curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement. We believe the best ideas come from people who ask questions, challenge assumptions, embrace new technology, and are always looking for better ways to serve clients.

If you're excited about helping shape the future of performance marketing, not simply managing campaigns, you'll fit right in.

Instacart is a Flex First team

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Overview

Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

About the Job

Run the operating rhythm

  • Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.
  • Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.
  • Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.
  • Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).
  • Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).
  • Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.
  • Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.
  • Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

Plan executive communication

  • Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.
  • Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health

  • Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.
  • Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.
  • Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

Drive priority programs

  • Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.
  • Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.
  • Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of work experience
  • R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization
  • Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives
  • Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.
  • High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level
  • Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.
  • Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.
  • Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.
  • Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

JoinphData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year

We are looking for an AI Services lead to join our Client Services team. This role will lead our commercial strategy, methodology, and client success for the Anthropic private equity channel. To succeed, you will build credibility with Anthropic and with operating and investment partners at PE firms, demonstrating that you and phData can guide them in integrating Anthropic - and data and AI more broadly - into their value-creation strategies.

You understand the different types of PE firms and how they think about EBITDA improvement, hold periods, and exit multiples. You know how operating and investment partners evaluate the business value of data and AI, where AI can create measurable enterprise value across a portfolio, and how to translate those opportunities into a pipeline of high-conviction engagements that phData and Anthropic can win and deliver together.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the private equity vertical within the Anthropic partnership, building and managing relationships at the fund level and driving AI activation and client success across portfolio companies.
  • Partner with funds and portcos to develop and apply AI value creation frameworks tailored to PE investment theses, connecting Claude-powered solutions to EBITDA improvement, operational efficiency, and exit readiness.

About You

You are financially fluent, commercially aggressive, and deeply familiar with how private equity firms evaluate and create value. You understand that in PE, everything is measured, and you hold your AI programs to the same standard. The traits below aren't aspirational; they describe who you already are:

  • Extreme Ownership: You consider "business as usual" in your account plan a failure. Stagnant accounts are a personal problem you refuse to tolerate. You push action, create momentum, and treat every week without a clear next use case as a gap you need to close.
  • Order Maker, Not Order Taker: PE firms don't hire advisors who respond to RFPs. They hire people who come in with a point of view on where value is being left on the table and a concrete plan to capture it. You are that person. You walk into every GP meeting with a proposed next chapter, not a recap of the last one.
  • Financially Grounded: You speak the language of private equity fluently, EBITDA, hold period, operating leverage, portfolio roll-up, and exit multiple. You don't need someone to translate business outcomes into financial impact. You do that yourself, and you build it into every proposal you write.
  • Attention to Detail: You believe sloppy account management is a trust destroyer, and trust is harder to rebuild in PE than in any other industry. The account plan is accurate. The value creation tracker is live. The engagement status reflects reality. You don't let things drift.

Required Qualifications

  • 10–15+ years of experience in a hybrid client advisory and commercial role within consulting, professional services, or financial services with direct accountability for engagement quality and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated experience working with or within private equity firms, portfolio companies, or financial services organizations with a clear understanding of how PE firms make investment and operating decisions.
  • Track record scoping and delivering $500K–$5M+ services programs with measurable financial outcomes (EBITDA improvement, cost reduction, revenue acceleration, or operational efficiency).
  • History of building multi-account, multi-engagement programs, not just managing individual projects with responsibility for the growth of the overall portfolio.
  • Proven ability to operate at the GP, CFO, and operating partner level as a credible, trusted advisor, not just a delivery contact.
  • Experience building AI or data value creation frameworks that connect technology investment to quantifiable business and financial outcomes.
  • Comfort operating with limited structure in a high-growth, matrixed environment where the playbook is still being written.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% based on client and partner needs.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Sufficient AI/data fluency to shape engagements involving agentic AI, LLM-powered workflows, and data infrastructure, including RAG, agent orchestration, MCP-style integrations, and AI evals without requiring a technical co-lead to define the solution.
  • Direct experience with Anthropic (Claude for Work, API, or Enterprise) or a comparable LLM platform, with the ability to articulate where Claude creates differentiated value for financial services use cases.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role.

  • CPA, CFA, or MBA with a finance or accounting concentration, or equivalent, demonstrating financial fluency in a client-facing role.
  • Direct experience building or operating within a PE-focused practice at a consulting or technology services firm.
  • Prior success designing and executing AI value creation programs specifically within PE-backed portfolio companies with documented financial impact.
  • Existing relationships within the private equity ecosystem (GPs, operating partners, portfolio CFOs) that are relevant to the Anthropic partnership.
  • Experience in structuring fund-level AI strategies that span multiple portfolio companies under a single investment thesis.

Why phData?

  • Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data and AI initiatives.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways.
