About the Team:

The Advanced Placement team supports College Board in serving more than seven million students a year as they prepare for a successful transition to college through programs and services in college readiness and college success — speciﬁcally through the Advanced Placement (AP) Program. With more than 40 courses in a variety of subject areas, we are committed to promoting innovation, equity, and excellence for generations of students.

The AP Web Content team is responsible for defining and executing content strategy across a large, interconnected set of AP digital properties. We work closely with stakeholders across the AP Program and College Board to translate program goals into clear, user-friendly web content that supports students and educators. Our team balances big-picture content strategy with day-to-day execution—organizing information, creating content, and ensuring it’s easy to find and use. In a fast-paced, high-volume environment, we help bring consistency and clarity to the AP web experience.

About the Opportunity:

Under the direction of the AP Web Content Manager, the AP Web Editorial and Content Strategist is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping and executing content strategy across AP and Pre-AP web properties. This role ensures that content is user-centered, cohesive, scalable, and aligned with AP program goals.

This position plays a critical role in supporting the launch of new AP course content, as well as ongoing course and exam revisions, within a large and complex web ecosystem. The strategist will partner closely with stakeholders across the AP Program and College Board to transform complex, interdependent inputs into clear, effective digital experiences.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with a strong emphasis on content structure, findability, and long-term sustainability.

In this role, you will:

Content Strategy and Structure (25%)

  • Own and drive editorial and content strategy for key areas of AP web properties, ensuring content is organized, scalable, and aligned with user needs and business goals.

  • Define where and how new content should live within an increasingly large and complex site, balancing user needs, SEO/findability, and maintainability.

  • Guide information architecture, content models, taxonomy, and metadata decisions in collaboration with cross-functional partners.

  • Structure and shape page-level experiences (hierarchy, flow, messaging) to improve usability and engagement.

  • Identify content gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for consolidation or improvement across AP web properties.

Content Creation and Execution (60%)

  • Translate complex, ambiguous, or inconsistently developed stakeholder inputs into clear, structured, and effective web content.

  • Lead content planning across the full lifecycle—from early concept and planning through launch—including defining content requirements, conducting content audits, drafting and editing content, determiningoptimal content strategy/placement, performing quality control and maintaining ongoing optimization.

  • Create and edit high-quality web content, ensuring clarity, consistency, and adherence to brand and editorial standards.

  • Work within the CMS to publish and maintain content, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

Stakeholder Partnership & Content Operations (15%)

  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on content direction.

  • Contribute to and help evolve content governance, standards, and workflows to support a growing content ecosystem.

  • Balance multiple competing priorities and deadlines across projects with varying levels of complexity and ambiguity.

About You:

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex and highly nuanced inputs into clear, user-friendly content.

  • 7-10 years of experience in content strategy, editorial, or digital content roles, ideally within large, complex web environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading content strategy for large-scale websites, platforms, or ecosystems. Strong experience working with information architecture, taxonomy, and content organization at scale.

  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring clarity, structure, and direction to content initiatives.

  • Experience partnering with diverse stakeholders and influencing decisions without direct authority.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining high quality and attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and digital publishing workflows.

  • Experience working within structured editorial standards, workflows, and governance models.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to articulate content decisions and strategy to non-content stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with education, curriculum, or mission-driven organizations is a plus.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While thehiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$115,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out ourcareers page for more.

Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. We are looking for a Product Manager, Analytics & AI to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Avetta's client-facing analytics and AI-powered insights capabilities. 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Er is een ruime hoeveelheid bestaande marketingcontent, wetenschappelijke expertise en inhoudelijke kennis beschikbaar over diverse toepassingsdomeinen, sectoren en klantengroepen. De kernuitdaging bestaat erin die kennis efficiënter, consistenter en gerichter om te zetten naar relevante content voor specifieke klantsegmenten.

Deze opdracht onderzoekt hoe AI kan ondersteunen bij het genereren en herwerken van content voor de juiste doelgroep, op basis van bestaande content, interne expertise, klantinzichten en waar relevant AI-gegenereerde aanvullingen.

De focus ligt niet alleen op automatische tekstproductie, maar vooral op het uitwerken van een herbruikbare aanpak waarmee marketingmedewerkers en business stakeholders AI kwalitatief, veilig en doelgericht kunnen inzetten. Daarbij zijn tone of voice, inhoudelijke juistheid, brongebruik, relevantie per segment, merkkwaliteit en menselijke review essentieel.

Concreet omvat de opdracht onder meer:

  • analyseren welke bestaande content bruikbaar is als basis voor AI-ondersteunde contentcreatie;
  • uitwerken hoe bestaande content vertaald kan worden naar een hero piece en afgeleiden voor verschillende kanalen, met focus op awareness of growth, zoals whitepapers, infographics en videoformaten;
  • afstemmen van content op verschillende klantsegmenten, sectoren en persona’s;
  • ontwikkelen van prompts, templates, AI-workflows en richtlijnen voor een consistente contentkwaliteit;
  • bewaken hoe generieke, foutieve of niet-conforme AI-output vermeden kan worden;
  • identificeren van opportuniteiten op basis van sectoractualiteit en relevante doelgroepen;
  • uitwerken hoe AI kan bijdragen aan een doelgroepgericht communicatieplan dat de zichtbaarheid bij de doelgroep verhoogt;
  • inspireren en begeleiden van interne medewerkers zodat zij zelf met AI aan de slag kunnen;
  • formuleren van governance rond brongebruik, review, publicatie en hergebruik van AI-gegenereerde content.

Verwachte resultaten

  1. Een analyse van relevante bestaande content en mogelijke segmenteringslogica.
  2. Een proof of concept voor AI-ondersteunde contentcreatie of contentherwerking voor enkele concrete klantsegmenten.
  3. Een set herbruikbare prompts, templates of workflows voor marketingcontent.
  4. Richtlijnen voor kwaliteit, tone of voice, brongebruik, fact-checking en human review, geïntegreerd in de proof of concept.
  5. Een inspiratiesessie of hands-on workshop voor interne medewerkers.
  6. Aanbevelingen voor verdere uitrol binnen marketing en business development.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt senior ervaring als communicatieconsultant.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare expertise in generatieve AI voor marketing en communicatie.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met AI-workflows voor contentstrategie en weet die om te zetten naar een praktische, herbruikbare aanpak.
  • Je hebt sterke ervaring in copywriting van corporate, marketing- en/of productcontent.
  • Je kan communicatieplannen opstellen en/of implementeren, inclusief doelgroepgerichte contentaanpakken.
  • Je volgt trends en ontwikkelingen binnen de digitale communicatiemarkt, contentmarketing en social media op de voet.
  • Je kan mensen inspireren, meenemen in verandering en interne teams enthousiasmeren om met AI te werken.
  • Je combineert strategisch inzicht met oog voor kwaliteit, tone of voice, inhoudelijke correctheid en menselijke validatie.

jobs.description:
Technical Product Marketing Manager

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions, from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times to drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We’re hiring our Technical Product Marketing Manager to be Product’s go-to-market counterpart from roadmap through launch, and the person who makes sure Customer Success, Sales, and Product are genuinely ready every time a release ships. This is a technical seat that sits in Marketing: you’ll work close to engineering, get hands-on with the product, and translate what we’re building into positioning and enablement that lands in the market and in the field.

You’ll play a central role in the go-to-market strategy behind each launch: positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and target-segment definition. You’ll shape it in close collaboration with other members of our marketing team, who own brand voice and the master narrative, and with Product, Sales, and Customer Success. Think of yourself as the clean handoff between what Product builds and how the market and our field teams understand it. Done well, a launch is something Product, Customer Success, and Sales feel ready for and proud of.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive launch go-to-market strategy for a product suite, in partnership with the broader team: positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and target-segment definition within our core Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
  • Partner deeply with Product through the roadmap and build cycle. That means sitting in on sprint reviews, using the product yourself, and spending real time with Performance Architects, Regional Sales Managers, and Solutions Engineers, including visits to the dealership
  • Create launch enablement that Customer Success and Sales rely on: positioning briefs, product requirement inputs, and the core collateral used to sell and support every release
  • Drive launch readiness across the org (Customer Success first, then Sales, then Product) by tracking certification and readiness against committed dates and escalating early when something is at risk
  • Build the launch playbook as you go: repeatable steps, aligned stakeholders, and clear communication channels that scale as Numa grows
  • Work AI-native by using AI tooling and writing light scripts and automations yourself to generate content, track readiness, and take repetitive work off your own plate
  • Protect real lead time by pushing for sufficient runway between product ideation and launch across the whole cross-functional group

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of product marketing experience, ideally at an early-stage or high-growth company, where you’ve owned launches end-to-end
  • Technical fluency close to engineering: you can read code, write a script, call an API, and use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) comfortably. You don’t need to ship production code, but you should hold your own with engineers and PMs and translate complex AI features for technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Cross-functional range: you’ve aligned product, sales, and marketing strategy before, and you know how to pick up someone else’s thinking and carry it to market without dropping it
  • Strong, targeted writing for positioning briefs, product requirement inputs, and competitive battlecards
  • Comfort with ambiguity: shifting inputs and an evolving process energize you; you build structure as you go rather than waiting for it to be handed to you

Nice To Have

  • Experience marketing technical or AI products to both technical and business audiences
  • Background in solutions engineering, developer relations, or a technical/product role with go-to-market instincts
  • Experience building a launch or go-to-market process from scratch, not just running an existing one

Say hello to opportunities.

It’s not every day that you consider starting a new career. We’re RingCentral, and we’re happy that someone as talented as you is considering this role. First, a little about us, we’re a $2.6 Billion annual revenue company with double digit Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and a $93 Billion market opportunity in UCaaS, Contact Center and AI-powered adjacencies. We invest more than $250 million annually to ensure our AI-enabled technology and platforms meet or exceed the needs of our customers.

AIR Pro is RingCentral’s agentic AI platform for enterprise voice and digital customer interactions. The platform enables organizations to automate customer experience conversations with measurable business outcomes. We have thousands of customers already running RingCentral AI products today. That install base is your deployment surface: real production traffic, real contact centers, real revenue on the line from day one.

This is where you and your skills come in. RingCentral is standing up a Forward-Deployed Engineering function. There is no playbook. You will help write it.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your time inside customer environments shipping production agentic AI systems: designing multi-turn voice and digital agents, building integrations to CRMs, EHRs, and ticketing systems, and instrumenting everything so outcomes are measurable.

You carry direct accountability for containment rates, handle-time reduction, and expansion, and you get the authority that goes with it: a defined escalation path into Product and Engineering, a standing mechanism for roadmap input based on what you hit in the field, and committed engineering support for platform blockers.

You will support pre-sales for your accounts (demos, POCs, technical scoping), and what you learn will shape how we hire, structure, and scale the FDE team. If you want a narrowly scoped lane, this isn't it. If you want to define a function inside a platform with a large enterprise base, it is.

Job Duties:

  • Own end to end strategic customer deployments. A focused portfolio, depth over breadth: discovery, workflow analysis (call routing, agent scripts, escalation paths, back-office handoffs), success criteria definition, production deployment, iteration, proven ROI, expansion.

  • Build production systems. Multi-turn agent workflows: prompt design, retrieval pipelines, decision logic, fallback handling, live-agent handoff. Integrations to customer systems of record. Guardrails and compliance controls (PII, HIPAA, PCI) fit to each environment.

  • Instrument everything. Deploy evaluation, monitoring, and testing frameworks so agent performance is continuously measured and improved. Success criteria are set before deployment, not reverse-engineered after.

  • Shape the platform. Your field findings feed roadmap prioritization directly. Document integration patterns, platform gaps, and recurring requirements with enough technical depth that Engineering can act on them.

  • Support the sale. Senior technical resource for your accounts pre-sales: live demonstrations, architectural conversations, proof-of-concept builds, deployment scoping alongside AEs and Sales Engineers. Turn pilot results into expansion cases.

The stack

You'll work directly with AIR Pro's agent orchestration layer, its APIs and integration framework, retrieval and knowledge tooling, and evaluation/observability infrastructure, plus whatever the customer runs (Salesforce, Epic, ServiceNow, custom APIs). You'll go deep on LLM behavior in production: prompt architecture, tool use, latency budgets for voice, failure modes, and evals.

Desired Qualifications:

Required

  • A strong engineer first. You write and ship production code (Python and/or TypeScript), build and debug API integrations independently, and have owned systems running in production. This is a hands-on-keyboard role.

  • 4+ years in customer-facing technical work where you personally built what was deployed: forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture with real implementation ownership, or technical consulting.

  • Working depth with LLMs in production: RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation. You've debugged why an agent fails, not just demoed one that works.

  • Communicates across the range: design reviews with engineers, business cases with executives, and difficult conversations with customers when a deployment needs to change course.

  • Thrives with incomplete information, competing priorities, and no one telling you what to do next.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent military/work experience.

Preferred

  • Voice/telephony depth: SIP, WebRTC, SBCs, or CCaaS/UCaaS platform experience. Voice agents are harder than chat, and this is a voice-first platform.

  • Enterprise-scale agentic AI deployments, voice or digital.

  • Industry depth in healthcare, financial services, retail, or insurance.

  • Familiarity with the competitive conversational AI landscape.

Why this role

  • Founding-hire leverage. Everything you build (deployment methodology, eval standards, integration patterns, hiring bar) becomes how the team works. That's rare inside a public company with an existing enterprise base to deploy into.

  • No cold start. You are not hunting for design partners. Strategic customers are already under contract and waiting for exactly this function.

  • Product influence with teeth. Structured, committed feedback loop into Product and Engineering, not a suggestion box.

What we offer:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance

  • Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs) and Commuter benefits

  • Voluntary supplemental health coverage and life insurance

  • 401K match and ESPP

  • Paid time off and paid sick leave

  • Paid parental and pregnancy leave

  • Family-forming benefits (IVF, Preservation, Adoption etc.)

  • Emergency backup care (Child/Adult/Pets)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7

  • Free legal services that provide legal advice, document creation and estate planning

  • Employee bonus referral program

  • Student loan refinancing assistance

  • Employee 1:1 coaching, perks and discounts program

RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success.

About RingCentral

RingCentral, Inc. (NYSE: RNG) is a leading provider of business cloud communications and contact center solutions based on its powerful Message Video Phone™  (MVP™) global platform. More flexible and cost effective than legacy on-premises PBX and video conferencing systems that it replaces, RingCentral® empowers modern mobile and distributed workforces to communicate, collaborate, and connect via any mode, any device, and any location. RingCentral is headquartered in Belmont, California, and has offices around the world.

jobs.excerpt: You know great products don't sell themselves.  The best ones are brought to market by people who deeply understand their customers, can simplify complex technology, and know how to tell stories that resonate with technical buyers.
jobs.description:
You know great products don't sell themselves. The best ones are brought to market by people who deeply understand their customers, can simplify complex technology, and know how to tell stories that resonate with technical buyers.

If you're passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy partnering across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and love translating technical capabilities into clear customer value, we'd love to talk.

At Expel, we're redefining how organizations approach Managed Detection and Response (MDR). In a market crowded with vendors focused on products, we focus on outcomes. Our customers trust us to help them detect, investigate, and respond to threats faster, and Product Marketing plays a critical role in helping tell that story.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll own product marketing for a key slice of Expel's portfolio, our threat hunting, phishing, and add-on services, alongside the orchestration and automation areas of our MDR service. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive stakeholders to develop messaging, launch new capabilities, enable customer-facing teams, and create compelling content that helps customers understand why Expel is different.

This role blends real ownership with hands-on execution. You'll drive strategy and GTM plans for your focus areas while partnering closely with a small, talented product marketing team. This isn't a role where you'll be flying solo, but it is one where you'll be trusted to run your own areas of the business.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you the opportunity to influence how one of the industry's leading MDR providers tells its story.
  • Surround you with collaborative Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Engineering teams that genuinely enjoy building together.
  • Give you the freedom to experiment with new messaging, launch strategies, and AI-powered workflows that help us move faster.
  • Let you own meaningful initiatives while continuing to grow your product marketing expertise.
  • Provide the opportunity to influence go-to-market strategy while remaining close to customers and products.

What you can do for Expel

  • Own product marketing for Expel's threat hunting, phishing, and add-on services portfolio, developing messaging, positioning, and GTM plans that establish these as recognized differentiators against competitors like CrowdStrike, Arctic Wolf, and ReliaQuest.
  • Partner closely with Product Management throughout the lifecycle of your focus areas, from roadmap through launch, to drive successful releases and customer adoption.
  • Refresh and maintain core messaging platforms and website/FAQ content for your focus areas, replacing outdated positioning with something sharper.
  • Deliver complete, on-time GTM launch packages, messaging, content, and enablement, for every release tied to your focus areas.
  • Build and deliver sales and Customer Success enablement that helps customer-facing teams confidently position your focus areas, handle objections, and communicate customer value.
  • Create high-quality customer-facing content including messaging frameworks, solution briefs, webpages, presentations, blogs, battlecards, and technical sales collateral.
  • Develop and maintain competitive intelligence, messaging, battlecards, and market analysis, that helps sellers win throughout the sales cycle.
  • Turn market, competitive, and customer insights into recommendations that directly inform roadmap prioritization decisions.
  • Partner with Marketing to launch content and demand-generation programs tied to each planned release in your focus areas.
  • Launch prospect and customer engagement programs that grow qualified pipeline and expansion for your product areas.
  • Spend time with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand buyer challenges, market dynamics, and evolving security priorities.
  • Represent Expel through webinars, customer engagements, analyst briefings, and industry events as a subject matter expert on your focus areas.
  • Leverage AI tools such as Gemini and Claude to accelerate research, messaging development, competitive analysis, and content creation.

What you should bring with you

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify highly technical cybersecurity concepts for multiple audiences.
  • Solid experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, Technical Marketing, Sales Engineering, or a similar go-to-market role.
  • Experience working within cybersecurity or a closely related technical B2B SaaS environment.
  • Experience marketing cybersecurity technologies such as MDR, XDR, SIEM, SecOps, cloud security, identity security, or adjacent markets is a strong plus.
  • A track record running product launches big and small, knowing who to bring in and when, and owning stakeholder management from kickoff through release.
  • The ability to quickly learn a new product space and translate customer, persona, and market insights into GTM strategies and content plans.
  • Comfort driving alignment across technical PMs, Sales, Marketing, and business stakeholders, and delivering enablement to internal and external audiences, including customers and analysts.
  • Demonstrated skill building messaging and positioning that speaks to key personas and differentiates Expel in the market.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while consistently delivering high-quality work.
  • A customer-first mindset with genuine curiosity to understand buyer pain points and translate those insights into stronger messaging.
  • Experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day workflows to improve productivity and accelerate content development.
  • A Bachelor's degree or a compelling story.

Additional notes

The base salary range for this role is between $130,600 USD and $189,400 USD + bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

ConvaTec is building a data function and data governance is central to that build. This is a critical delivery role within it. This role will contribute to making Convatec’s data findable, traceable and trustworthy.

Working with the business the Data Governance Analyst will support core elements of our data governance capability – the business glossary and data catalogue in Microsoft Purview, data lineage and a data quality framework that moves us from finding problems in reports to preventing them at source.

Our governance capability is being stood up from the ground up so the candidate will be comfortable establishing new processes and artefacts and equally comfortable with business stakeholders to get them adobted with the support of data leadership.

About Role

1. Data Cataloguing and Metadata Management

  • Build, populate and maintain the enterprise business glossary and data catalogue in Microsoft Purview (for example Finance & FP&A, Commerial, CRM, Supply Chain).

  • Adminstor the tooling so catalogue does not decay after go-live.

  • Engage data owners, stewards and subject matter experts to agree and publish common definitions for critical data elements, resolving conflicting versions to a single agreed source, and enforcing the metadata standards that make catalogue entries genuinely usable.

2. Data Lineage

  • Capture and maintain end-to-end lineage for critical data elements across the full pipeline and documented in a form both engineers and business stakeholders can act on.

  • Estalish change impact analysis so that upstream source change identifies and warns the affected downstream reports, models and consumers in advance.

3. Data Quality

  • Work with business data owners and governance sponsors to translate business risk into testable data quality rules across the recognised dimensions, and implement them as automated, monitored checks with dashboards, agreed thresholds and a defined exception route.

  • Profile data, lead root cause analysis on quality issues through to conclusion with measurable outcomes and manage data quality issues log end to end.

  • Support the shift from reactive reconciliation to preventative controls applied at the point of capture or ingestion.

4. Governance Framework, Stewardship and Adoption

  • Support the implementation of the data governance framework, policies and standards, producing clear, user-friendly documentation and guidance that the business will use.

  • Help embed the ownership and stewardship model.

  • Contribute to governance KPIs and KRIs.

About You

  • Proven experience (typically 3+ years) in Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Management or a closely adjacent role in a large or complex organization.

  • Demonstratable hands-on experience of at least two of: Business Glossary, Data Catalogue, Data lineage or Data Quality

  • Experience with Microsoft Purview is desirable

  • Practical experience implementing or configuring a data governance or cataloguing tool.

  • Proven ability to bridge business and technology.

Desirable

  • Experience working in S4/Hana or SAP environment

  • Experience with dedicated data quality or observability tooling

jobs.description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 260 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Build pipeline. Prove impact. Fuel growth.

At Zyte, the Head of Demand Generation owns the engine that turns marketing investment into qualified pipeline across three product motions: Zyte API (self-serve, PLG), Zyte API Enterprise (sales-led), and Zyte Data (sales-led). You'll lead demand generation programs end-to-end, working hand-in-hand with Sales, Developer Relations, and Content to make sure every campaign and channel is measured against one outcome: pipeline and revenue impact.

You'll build and lead a small, high-performing team, partnering closely with the Head of New Business, the BDR team, and the Head of Revenue Operations to align messaging and lead handoff. Reporting to the CMO, you'll bring rigor to how Zyte plans, executes, and reports on marketing's contribution to the funnel across every motion we run.

If you're a data-driven marketing leader who thinks in pipeline, not just impressions, and you're comfortable running multiple playbooks in parallel, this is your opportunity to own demand generation at a fast-growing data extraction company.

Roles & Responsibilities

Across all funnels:

  • Own the demand generation strategy across paid, organic, and email channels to drive qualified pipeline for self-serve, enterprise motions.- Zyte API and Zyte Enterprise.
  • Define, track, and report on pipeline and revenue metrics (MQLs, SQLs, pipeline generated, conversion rates, CAC, ROI) by funnel to the CMO and senior leadership.
  • Manage and forecast the demand generation budget, allocating spend to the highest-performing channels and programs per funnel.
  • Hire, coach, and develop a small team of demand gen marketers.
  • Own the marketing technology stack for demand gen (marketing automation, CRM integration, analytics tools).
  • Present regular pipeline forecasts and campaign performance reviews to senior management for business planning.

Zyte API (PLG self-serve funnel):

  • Drive trial signups and subscriber conversion through paid search (Google PPC), SEO, and AEO strategies, with deep hands-on expertise across all three.
  • Run experiments and A/B tests across campaigns to continuously improve funnel conversion.
  • Work closely with Developer Relations to align top-of-funnel content and community activity with paid and organic acquisition goals.

Enterprise funnel (Zyte API Enterprise & Zyte Data):

  • Build the marketing-to-sales handoff process, ensuring lead scoring, routing, and follow-up are tight and well documented.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to align on target segments, messaging, and lead prioritization across both enterprise products.
  • Support and help scale an ABM motion aligned to named target accounts, working with Content to build account-specific assets.
  • Run campaigns in direct support of outbound efforts from the sales team, coordinating cadence and messaging with BDRs and Account Executives.
  • Work with Content to develop the deeper, more technical materials the sales-led motion requires.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or revenue marketing, with at least 2 years in a management role.
  • Proven track record building and scaling demand generation programs across more than one funnel type (self-serve/PLG and enterprise), ideally including ABM.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Google PPC and SEO, with working knowledge of or demonstrated interest in AEO — these are core levers in this role.
  • Strong command of pipeline and funnel metrics, and the ability to tie marketing activity directly to revenue outcomes, by funnel.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales/BDR teams on messaging, lead handoff, ABM, and outbound support.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Developer Relations and Content teams, not just Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms, and comfort working inside a CRM.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and forecast a demand generation budget across multiple motions.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • High level of analytical rigor, with the ability to turn campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Previous experience in a SaaS / PaaS company, specifically supporting sales to Enterprise accounts, is a plus.
  • Understanding of data harvesting / web crawling a plus — but not necessary.
  • Creativity and initiative combined with strong commercial awareness.

Benefits

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom & flexibility to work remotely.
  • Get the chance to work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areKentik is the network intelligence platform for modern infrastructure teams.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Kentik is the network intelligence platform for modern infrastructure teams. Unlike traditional monitoring and observability tools, we demystify complex network operations, enabling organizations to deliver applications and innovation at scale. Built by network experts to make critical insight accessible to every engineer, Kentik is the real-time source of truth that understands every network in context — from data center to cloud to the internet. This single platform unifies and correlates cloud, device, flow, and synthetic data to turn telemetry into action. Market leaders like Akamai, Booking.com, Dropbox, and Zoom rely on Kentik to run, manage, and optimize their networks.

What we do

Kentik's Platform Engineering group is responsible for storing, enriching, and querying traffic metadata and metrics from the world's largest networks. Our platform actively monitors infrastructure, triggers automated responses to outages and attacks, and is critical to delivering complete network observability to our customers.

To do this, our single platform unifies and correlates cloud, device, flow, and synthetic data to turn telemetry into action. This means our storage layer must ingest trillions of records and serve hundreds of thousands of queries each day with absolute reliability. The scale and complexity we operate at isn't just large; it’s industry-defining.

The Platform Engineering group consists of three teams: Ingest, Storage and Query, and Network Data enrichments. Our Storage Team is looking for a technical leader to help us design and scale the next generation of our high-performance, data-intensive storage layer.

What you'll do

As a Sr Staff Engineer, you will co-own the technical vision for our storage services. This is a role with high autonomy, high visibility, and deep technical impact. You will:

  • Help define and lead the execution of a multi-year technical roadmap for Storage, pushing the boundaries of industry-leading query speeds
  • Design tiered storage strategies (Hot/Warm/Cold), TTL-based data eviction, and optimization strategies that handle massive, real-time data influx.
  • Work closely with product, support, and other engineering teams to drive platform-wide storage standards, while leveling up the engineers around you.
  • Thrive in our remote-first, highly collaborative culture where independence and clear communication are celebrated

What you'll bring

Studies have shown that some candidates tend to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to apply if you meet most of the criteria - even if you don’t match all of the qualifications, your skills and experience could be valuable in this role!

  • Deep Distributed Systems Expertise: You have a proven track record of designing, building, and scaling high-throughput, concurrent data pipelines
  • Systems Programming Fluent: You love working in languages optimized for performance, specifically Go, C, or Rust
  • Storage Layer Knowledge: You have experience working closely with (or building) Timeseries Databases, object storage, or distributed filesystems
  • Architectural Pragmatism: You know how to balance cutting-edge engineering with operational stability and business needs
  • Strong Communication Skills: You can articulate complex technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Growth Mindset: You have a passion to grow personally and actively contribute to a high-performing team culture

Our tech stack

  • Our core data engine and platform are primarily written in Go
  • We use Node.js + Express for application serving, and React as our primary UI framework

jobs.title: AI Solution Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Our CompanyExplore how you can contribute at AmeriLife.
jobs.description:
Our Company

Explore how you can contribute at AmeriLife.

For over 50 years, AmeriLife has been a leader in the development, marketing and distribution of annuity, life and health insurance solutions for those planning for and living in retirement.

Associates get satisfaction from knowing they provide agents, marketers and carrier partners the support needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving industry.

Job Summary

AmeriLife is a national leader in insurance and financial services, and we are standing up an enterprise AI capability from the ground up. The model is deliberately federated: a small, senior center owns the data platform, reusable AI services, and governance — while solution architects embedded in our Health and Wealth verticals find the highest-value work and build it alongside the business.

This is one of the first of those embedded roles, and it is a builder’s job. You will spend most of your time engineering and shipping AI agents and LLM-powered services on Databricks and Azure — automating real workflows in contracting, commissions, and distribution operations where a national platform gives the economics real scale. The rest of your time draws on classic data science: the forecasting, propensity, and evaluation work that makes those solutions trustworthy and measurable.

Job Description

Role Breakdown

  • Agentic AI engineering & implementation: Designing, building, evaluating, and shipping multi-step AI agents and LLM-powered services into production
  • Solution architecture & business partnership: Finding and shaping high-value use cases with vertical leaders; reference architecture, reusable patterns, build-vs-buy input
  • Applied data science & ML: Forecasting, propensity and segmentation models, evaluation design, and the feature engineering behind both agents and models

What You'll Do

Build and ship AI agents

  • Design, build, and deploy multi-step AI agents that complete real business workflows — retrieving from governed data, calling internal APIs and tools, making bounded decisions, and escalating to a human when they should.
  • Engineer the unglamorous parts that make agents work: tool and function definitions, retrieval and grounding strategy, state and memory, orchestration, retries and failure handling, cost and latency management.
  • Build evaluation into the build, not after it. Golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review, and guardrails you can point at when someone asks how you know it works.
  • Instrument and operate what you ship. Tracing, monitoring, drift and quality alerting, and a clear owner for every production surface.
  • Harvest reusable components into the shared services catalog so the next solution costs less than yours did.

Architect solutions with the business

  • Embed with your vertical’s leaders — operations, distribution, affiliate partners — observing the actual work rather than waiting on a written spec.
  • Translate business problems into solution designs, including the honest version: what is automatable today, what needs process work first, and what is not worth building.
  • Establish reference architectures and preferred patterns for your vertical, and contribute them back to the center.
  • Bring judgment to build-versus-buyand to the question of when an agent is the right answer versus a model, a rule, or a fixed process.

Apply data science where it moves the outcome

  • Build and validate predictive models — forecasting, propensity, segmentation, anomaly detection — that inform planning or drive an automated decision.
  • Engineer features and pipelines on the Lakehouse that serve both your models and your agents.
  • Design the measurement. Baselines, holdouts, A/B and quasi-experimental designs, and a defensible read on whether the thing actually worked.
  • Communicate results plainly to audiences that range from engineers to distribution executives.

Deliver responsibly in a regulated business

  • Document intended use, limitations, training-data assumptions, testing approach, and monitoring plan for every model and agent you put into production, and keep the model inventory current.
  • Apply de-identification and least-privilege access as defaults when working with PHI, financial, or Medicare-related data.
  • Flag fairness and unfair-discrimination risk on anything touching underwriting, rating, or pricing, and route it for actuarial and compliance review.
  • Build for auditability — reproducible code, documented lineage and methodology, and recordkeeping that holds up under HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, CMS, and state insurance requirements.

Technical Requirements

Agentic AI Engineering & Implementation

Required

  • 3+ years building AI or ML systems in production, including hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered agents or multi-step AI workflows — not just consuming AI tools
  • Practical fluency with at least one agent framework or SDK (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, LangChain, Databricks Mosaic AI Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to reason about why you chose it
  • Tool and function calling: defining tools, wiring agents to internal APIs and data, and handling structured outputs reliably
  • RAG and grounding in practice — chunking and retrieval strategy, vector search, semantic and hybrid retrieval, and knowing when retrieval is the wrong answer
  • Prompt and context engineering as an engineering discipline: versioned, tested, and evaluated rather than hand-tuned
  • Systematic AI evaluation — building eval sets, measuring quality and regression, and implementing guardrails for accuracy, safety, and cost
  • Sound judgment on traditional ML versus generative AI versus deterministic automation, and the trade-offs of each

Preferred

  • Hands-on work with Claude (Agent SDK, Claude Code, Model Context Protocol) and/or building on Microsoft Copilot — Copilot Studio agents, M365 Copilot declarative agents and extensibility, Copilot connectors
  • Building or consuming MCP servers to expose enterprise data and tools to agents
  • Multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflow design, or long-running agent state management
  • Document intelligence and unstructured-data extraction at scale (forms, contracts, statements)
  • LLM fine-tuning or adaptation, and a clear-eyed view of when it beats prompting or retrieval

Databricks Platform

Required

  • Strong hands-on Databricks experience — notebooks, clusters, jobs and Workflows, and developing production-grade code rather than one-off analysis
  • Advanced SQL and solid PySpark for large-scale transformation and feature engineering on a Lakehouse
  • Unity Catalog for governance, lineage, and access control; Delta Lake and medallion architecture patterns
  • MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment

Preferred

  • Databricks Mosaic AI — Agent Framework, Vector Search, Model Serving, AI Gateway, or Foundation Model APIs
  • Delta Live Tables, Feature Store, Lakehouse Federation, or Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Databricks certification (Data Engineer Professional, ML Engineer Professional, or Generative AI Engineer Associate)

Azure Cloud & Engineering Foundations

Required

  • Production experience on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry, and deploying services that other systems depend on
  • Strong Python engineering practice: modular, tested, reviewable code with Git-based version control
  • API design and integration — REST, authentication and secrets handling, and integrating with enterprise systems of record
  • Containerization (Docker) and CI/CD for data and AI workloads
  • Working understanding of cloud-native architecture, identity and RBAC, and data governance in a regulated environment

Preferred

  • Azure Data Factory, Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Entra ID, Azure DevOps, or Logic Apps
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep) and MLOps / LLMOps practice
  • Azure certification (AI Engineer Associate, Data Scientist Associate, or Solutions Architect Expert)

Applied Data Science & Machine Learning

Required

  • Solid foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning, with the judgment to match the method to the business problem
  • Experience building and validating supervised models on structured data (gradient boosting, regression, classification) and taking at least one to production
  • Time-series forecasting experience, and comfort with hypothesis testing and rigorous model evaluation
  • Comfort with imperfect real-world data — missing values, class imbalance, drift, and inconsistent source systems

Preferred

  • Clustering, anomaly detection, causal inference, uplift modeling, or Bayesian methods
  • Experiment design and measurement in an operational (non-web) setting
  • Optimization or simulation applied to a business process

Solution Architecture & Business Partnership

Required

  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with non-technical business leaders — discovering opportunities, framing problems, and setting expectations honestly
  • Full production ownership from problem definition through deployment, adoption, and iteration
  • Experience leading delivery at the project or pod level: planning, sequencing, and accountability for an outcome
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a technical trade-off to an executive in a paragraph

Preferred

  • Insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry — Medicare distribution, life and annuity, producer contracting, or commissions especially relevant
  • Experience in a federated or multi-affiliate organization where influence matters more than authority
  • Consulting, forward-deployed, or embedded-engineering background
  • Track record of raising the technical bar around you — patterns, reviews, enablement, mentorship

Our Tech Stack

  • Data & AI Platform: Databricks on Azure — Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake / Delta Live Tables, Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Vector Search, Model Serving), MLflow, Workflows
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure — Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Functions, Data Factory, API Management, Key Vault, Entra ID, DevOps
  • Agent & LLM Tooling: Claude (Agent SDK, Claude Code, MCP), Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility & Copilot Studio, LangGraph / LangChain, Model Context Protocol servers
  • Languages: Python, SQL, PySpark; TypeScript a plus
  • ML & DS: scikit-learn, XGBoost / LightGBM, statsmodels / Prophet-class forecasting, MLflow evaluation

Education, Location, & Travel

Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced and execution-oriented Manager of Customer Success Management to lead a team of high producing CSMs within our B2B, AMER sales division. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for overseeing day-to-day sales activities, inspiring achievement of sales targets, and ensuring our sales processes are optimized to drive growth.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Role

The Manager of Customer Success Management, AMER will be responsible for managing a group of North America's CSM team. This is a hands-on sales management position, responsible for contributing to predictable existing sales velocity and the professional development of high-performing sales representatives on the team. You will manage the team responsible for client health and adoption of our cloud-based, award-winning cybersecurity platform. This is a strategic role within the company, with many touchpoints in the field (both pre and post-sale) as well as internal facing with product management and marketing.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage and motivate a team of Customer Success Managers focused on actioning renewals, expansions and upsells and driving revenue growth
  • Drive revenue retention via a highly efficient, scalable customer renewal engine
  • Generate incremental bookings within existing accounts from subscription expansion and upsell of add-on portfolio products
  • Help directly manage Tier 1, high priority client relationships
  • Collaborate with Customer Support to ensure accurate and complete on-boarding of new clients and lanes
  • Partner with Sales to develop strategies and team goals to improve product penetration rates and expand Keeper’s footprint within existing customer portfolio
  • Proactively monitor assigned client health through quantitative and qualitative means
  • Own the optimization of contracts and other documents supporting renewals

  • Join customer calls alongside sales reps to provide strategic support, assist in advancing deals toward closure, and deliver real-time coaching to optimize sales conversations and outcomes
  • Analyze sales data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting
  • Collaborate closely with the marketing team to ensure alignment on lead generation, campaigns, and messaging
  • Continuously refine and optimize sales processes and tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness
  • Maintain a deep understanding of Keeper’s product offerings, customer needs, and market dynamics
  • Drive a high-energy, positive sales culture that motivates the team to perform at their best
  • Ability to travel to and from customer meetings (locally, nationally, and internationally) & rent and/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in full cycle SaaS sales (with a focus on upselling and expansion), IAM or cybersecurity experience is required
  • 3+ years of proven full cycle sales leadership, team lead or management experience
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets held by a sales team
  • Strong knowledge of SaaS sales processes, expansions, renewals and CRM systems, Salesforce experience preferred
  • Ability to construct, present and execute territory-level sales strategies
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire, mentor and develop a team
  • Data-driven mindset with experience analyzing sales metrics to drive decision-making
  • Ability to adapt in a fast-paced, ever-changing market environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to handle challenges and find creative solutions
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time

Benefits

jobs.title: Project Mobilisation & Travel Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryKDCI Outsourcing is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Mobilisation & Travel Administrator to coordinate personnel mobilisation, domestic and international travel, subcontractor compliance, and operational administration for project teams.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

KDCI Outsourcing is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Mobilisation & Travel Administrator to coordinate personnel mobilisation, domestic and international travel, subcontractor compliance, and operational administration for project teams. This role ensures employees, contractors, and visitors are mobilisation-ready, travel arrangements are accurately coordinated, compliance requirements are met, and documentation remains complete and up to date. The ideal candidate is an effective communicator who can independently manage multiple projects and competing priorities while collaborating closely with project teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Travel Coordination

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel bookings for employees, including flights, accommodation, vehicle hire, and airport transfers.

  • Arrange charter flights and ferry bookings where required to support project and site access.

  • Manage travel changes, cancellations, and emergency travel requirements, responding promptly as project demands shift.

  • Prepare clear travel itineraries and communicate these to travellers, project managers, and other stakeholders.

  • Liaise with travellers, project managers, and travel suppliers to confirm requirements and resolve issues.

  • Source cost-conscious travel options that balance budget, traveller welfare, and project timelines.

  • Prepare travel reports and maintain accurate travel records for business and project purposes.

Project Mobilisation

  • Coordinate mobilisation for employees and contractors, ensuring personnel are mobilisation-ready before project commencement.

  • Monitor and track licences, competencies, medicals, drug and alcohol requirements, VOCs, High Risk Work Licences, and trade qualifications.

  • Coordinate client and site inductions and maintain accurate training records for all personnel.

  • Upload and maintain documentation within client and internal systems, ensuring records are current and complete.

  • Manage mobilisation registers, proactively identifying missing documentation and following up on renewals.

  • Monitor expiry dates and coordinate renewals well ahead of project deadlines to avoid delays.

  • Liaise closely with HSEQ, HR, Project Managers, and clients to align mobilisation activities with project schedules.

Subcontractor Compliance Management

  • Coordinate subcontractor pre-qualification, ensuring all required documentation, including licences, insurances, and certifications, is submitted, reviewed, and verified before engagement.

  • Track and verify subcontractor insurances, including public liability, workers compensation, and professional indemnity, ensuring currency and adequate coverage levels.

  • Maintain subcontractor compliance registers, monitor expiry dates for insurances, licences, and certifications, and proactively follow up on renewals.

  • Review subcontractor documentation for compliance with company and client requirements, escalating gaps or non-conformances to HSEQ, Procurement, or Project Managers as required.

  • Ensure subcontractors are not mobilised to a project without verified and current compliance documentation.

  • Ensure compliance registers are accurate, complete, and reviewed proactively ahead of expiry.

  • Identify and promptly escalate compliance gaps or non-conformances.

  • Provide subcontractors and internal stakeholders with clear and timely communication regarding compliance requirements and status.

  • Maintain accurate and organized compliance reporting that is available to Project Managers and clients as required.

  • Liaise with subcontractors to obtain outstanding documentation and resolve compliance queries.

  • Upload and maintain subcontractor compliance records within client and internal systems.

  • Support the onboarding of new subcontractors, ensuring compliance status is confirmed before mobilisation.

  • Prepare compliance status reports for Project Managers and clients as required.

  • Support audits and reviews of subcontractor compliance as required.

Team Support & Engagement

  • Communicate positively and professionally with project teams and colleagues.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships across the business.

  • Participate in team meetings and provide updates as required.

  • Demonstrate and uphold company values in day-to-day work.

  • Support colleagues and maintain a strong customer service mindset in all interactions.

Professional Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and develop personal knowledge and skills relevant to the role.

  • Identify opportunities to improve business processes and drive efficiencies.

  • Embrace new technology and support the adoption of automation where relevant.

Workplace Health & Safety

  • Comply with all WH&S obligations and identify and report hazards relating to the workplace.

  • Demonstrate commitment to personal well-being and health.

Requirements

Job Requirements

Must Have

  • Experience in administration, mobilisation, travel coordination, or project support.

  • High-level organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and projects simultaneously.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Customer service experience with the ability to communicate professionally with employees, contractors, clients, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project teams.

  • Ability to proactively follow up on documentation, compliance requirements, renewals, and outstanding actions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in mobilisation, including FIFO mobilisation, is an advantage.

  • Experience using client portals such as Hammertech, Donesafe, CM3, Avetta, Rapid Global, or similar platforms.

  • Document control experience.

  • Experience using travel booking systems.

Highlights

Support project mobilisation, travel coordination, and subcontractor compliance activities.

jobs.excerpt: About RemoteRemote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease.
jobs.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

About this role

We are looking for a senior partnerships leader to own the commercial success and ongoing relationship with a portfolio of Remote’s most strategic embedded partners.

This person will be responsible for driving bookings & ARR across partner-sold and partner-sourced motions (quota carrying). They will own the revenue line for these partnerships and will be accountable for making the partnerships successful commercially, operationally, and strategically.

The role sits at the intersection of partner relationship management, sales leadership, go-to-market execution, and cross-functional orchestration. The primary focus is commercial: helping partners generate demand, enable their sellers, close deals, improve conversion, and build repeatable motions that allow them to sell Remote products increasingly independently. At the same time, this person will be the senior relationship owner for the partner, responsible for partnership health, executive engagement, issue resolution, and long-term expansion.

This is not a “manage the partner relationship and hope revenue follows” role. It is a commercial leadership role where the partnership relationship exists in service of revenue growth, partner independence, and long-term embedded success.

What you bring

  • Exceptionally sharp business judgement. You can understand the business objectives and stakeholder dynamics of a complex partner organization, and translate that to concrete actions.
  • Excellent communicator and evangelist. You can create and consistently communicate the partnership value message within the partner organization and Remote.
  • Strong operating rigor: you can turn ambiguity into repeatable plans, cadences, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence: you feel comfortable dealing with C-level execs.
  • Dare to dive deep: you operate cross-functionally with ease; you don’t shy away from detailed discussions with product, engineering, legal or compliance.
  • Deal maker: you create proposals ‘you can say yes to’ that create long term sustainable economics for both parties. You are able to be firm when needed.
  • Manage through influence: you are able to work with large strategic partners where success depends on influencing another company’s sales, marketing, product, and leadership teams.
  • Experience building, hiring and managing a high-performance team.
  • Willingness to travel 20–40%.
  • Experience owning revenue motions and owning a number. You own outcomes.
  • Experience in top-tier consulting, finance, or big tech - and in B2B tech startups/scaleups. You have the big and the small.
  • Experience building and operating new businesses, product, or sales motion. You build new systems, don’t just operate within them.
  • Bonus points for experience in HR Tech, Fin Tech, or Embedded partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own commercial outcomes for strategic embedded partners
  • Own a portfolio of Remote’s largest embedded HR technology partnerships.
  • Carry an annual bookings target of $10M+.
  • Be accountable for the commercial performance of the partnership, including pipeline generation, conversion, bookings, ARR, ASP, retention, and expansion.
  • Build and execute partner account plans that translate strategic partnership potential into measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Identify where revenue is blocked, where and why performance is below potential, and what needs to change across partner GTM, Remote GTM, product, process, enablement, pricing, or operations.
  • Manage commercial exceptions, pricing escalations, deal support, and channel conflicts where needed.

Make partners independently successful

  • Help partner sellers become increasingly independent in generating, qualifying, selling, and closing Remote opportunities.
  • Build repeatable partner sales motions across partner-sold, partner-sourced, and co-sold opportunities.
  • Work with partner sales leaders to embed Remote into their teams’ priorities, workflows, sales processes, and incentives.
  • Partner with enablement, solutions consulting, partner marketing, and embedded sales teams to ensure partner sellers know what to sell, how to sell it, and when to bring Remote in.
  • Drive a clear path from Remote-supported selling to partner-led selling, with the goal of reducing unnecessary dependency on Remote while improving commercial outcomes.

Lead senior partner relationships

  • Own the overall relationship health with strategic embedded partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior / C-level stakeholders within the partner organization across sales, marketing, product, operations, and executive leadership.
  • Keep partners engaged, motivated, and accountable to the joint commercial plan.
  • Unblock issues that slow down revenue growth or damage partner confidence.
  • Run structured business reviews with clear performance insights, decisions, next steps, and ownership.
  • Ensure the partner sees Remote as a critical strategic partner, not just another integration or referral option.

Define the embedded partner GTM model across the partner portfolio

  • Define, test, and optimize sales motions across partner-sold, partner-sourced, and co-sold models. Turn successful experiments into repeatable playbooks that can be used across partners.
  • Create playbooks for demand generation, enablement, sales process, partner seller activation, deal support, QBRs, and partner performance management.
  • Advise and influence partners to implement best practices for demand generation and embedded sales in their own organizations.
  • Identify friction between channels and work with Sales, Partnerships, RevOps, and leadership to resolve it. Share learnings so that Remote gets better with every partnership, not just within one account.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing embedded partnerships into new products, markets, customer segments, regions, or sales motions.

Manage and develop a high performing team

  • Manage a team of partner account managers and embedded sales leads supporting the partner portfolio. Set clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for the team.
  • Coach the team to balance short-term deal support with the longer-term goal of making partner sellers more independent.

Orchestrate Remote cross-functionally

  • Act as the commercial and relationship orchestrator across Remote for the partner portfolio.
  • Work closely with Product, Solution Architecture, Partner Marketing, Solutions Consulting, Legal, Compliance, Operations, CX, Implementation, RevOps, and Partner Success.
  • Ensure internal stakeholders understand the commercial priorities, partner context, trade-offs, and urgency.
  • Escalate clearly when decisions, resources, product changes, or executive support are needed.

Practicals

  • Team: Remote Embedded
  • Reporting line: GM Remote Embedded
  • Location: North America or Western Europe. The best timezones for this role are US Eastern Time or UK time.
  • Travel: 20–40% within North America and Europe.
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

Roughly 3 hours across 4 weeks

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  4. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$252,050—$425,300 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.
